cards.name: 短語_磨練出堅強的意志
cards.scene: A young boxer girl in training gloves punching a heavy bag, sweaty but with a strong, determined, never-give-up expression; a small glowing heart shape on her chest to show inner strength.

cards.name: 短語_締造出輝煌的成果
cards.scene: A team of children standing on a winners' podium holding a shining golden trophy together, confetti falling.

cards.name: 短語_設計出獨特的作品
cards.scene: A child at a craft table proudly showing a one-of-a-kind robot made from recycled boxes and bottle caps.

cards.scene: A child photographer holding a camera capturing the exact moment a dolphin jumps out of the water.

cards.name: 情境_鍛鍊出結實的肌肉
cards.scene: An older brother doing push-ups on a mat at home, his arms strong and muscular; a younger sibling counting and admiring.

cards.name: 情境_烘焙出好吃的餅乾
cards.scene: A school baking class: children in aprons take a tray of golden cookies out of an oven, smelling them happily.

cards.name: 情境_拼湊出完整的拼圖
cards.scene: A child cheering beside a completed 1000-piece jigsaw puzzle of a landscape on a table, the last piece just placed.

cards.name: 情境_栽種出新鮮的蔬菜
cards.scene: A school vegetable garden where students harvest fresh green leafy vegetables and put them in baskets, smiling.

cards.name: 短語_將挫折化為前進的動力

cards.name: 短語_將失敗化為成長的養分
cards.scene: A small plant growing tall out of a pot whose soil is made of crumpled failed drawings, showing failures feeding growth.

cards.name: 短語_將傳統化為創新的基礎
cards.scene: A child using traditional paper-cutting patterns to decorate a modern colorful lamp.

cards.name: 短語_將想像化為設計的元素

cards.name: 情境_將失敗化為前進的動力
cards.scene: A student at a desk carefully correcting mistakes on a test paper with a red pen, then studying hard with a determined face.

cards.name: 情境_將眼淚化為努力的力量
cards.scene: Two small panels: first a child crying after losing a race, then the same child wiping tears and training hard on the track.

cards.name: 情境_將垃圾化為再生的資源
cards.scene: Students sorting plastic bottles, paper and cans into recycling bins, with arrows showing them turning into new products like a bag and a bench.

cards.name: 短語_綻放生命的光彩

cards.name: 短語_展現學習的成效

cards.name: 短語_開創事業的高峰
cards.scene: An adult climbing to the top of a mountain-shaped staircase and planting a flag at the peak.

cards.name: 情境_享受努力的成果
cards.scene: A family eating ripe red tomatoes they grew themselves in a small backyard garden, everyone smiling.

cards.name: 情境_分享成功的喜悅
cards.scene: A child running home holding a medal and telling the family excitedly, everyone clapping and hugging.

cards.name: 情境_展現練習的成果
cards.scene: A child playing piano on a stage at a recital, confident and smiling, audience applauding.

cards.name: 情境_留下畢業的回憶
cards.scene: Graduation day: classmates in graduation caps posing together for a group photo, a teacher holding the camera.
